# How to Use YouTube with OptiSigns

Article URL: https://support.optisigns.com/hc/en-us/articles/360051014713-How-to-Use-YouTube-with-OptiSigns
Article ID: 360051014713

### In this article, we'll add a YouTube video or Short to OptiSigns, preview it, and put it on your screens.

- [Add a YouTube video](#AddAYouTubeVideo)
  - [YouTube Shorts](#YouTubeShorts)
- [Preview your video](#PreviewYourVideo)
- [Display options](#DisplayOptions)
- [Playback options](#PlaybackOptions)
- [Save your video](#SaveYourVideo)
- [Other YouTube apps](#OtherYouTubeApps)
- [Troubleshooting](#Troubleshooting)

Putting YouTube videos on your digital signs screens is easy with OptiSigns. You just need to copy the YouTube link and paste it into the YouTube app in OptiSigns. Then, assign it to your screens or put it in a Playlist.

---

## Add a YouTube video

First, you will need to have your screens set up and paired. For more information on how to do that, click [here](https://www.optisigns.com/blog/how-to-set-up-digital-signs-with-optisigns-and-amazon-fire-tv).

Log in to the OptiSigns portal, then go to **Files/Assets** and click **Apps**.

![OptiSigns Files/Assets page with the Apps button highlighted in the left panel](https://support.optisigns.com/hc/article_attachments/55742938300307)

Search for YouTube, then click **YouTube**:

![Add App dialog searched for YouTube, five YouTube apps listed, YouTube highlighted](https://support.optisigns.com/hc/article_attachments/55742925712531)

Enter your YouTube video information:

![YouTube app form with a video URL entered and the Playback options section showing Start At and End At](https://support.optisigns.com/hc/article_attachments/55742938310803)

- **Name** - Give your YouTube video a name. This is for displaying in your asset list only. It is optional: if you leave it blank, the app uses the video's title as the name when you save. You can change it to something else at any time.
- **URL** - Paste

# How to Use the YouTube Playlist App with OptiSigns

Article URL: https://support.optisigns.com/hc/en-us/articles/360059386254-How-to-Use-the-YouTube-Playlist-App-with-OptiSigns
Article ID: 360059386254
Source updated: 2026-09-14T18:47:59Z

Putting YouTube playlist on your digital signs screens is easy with OptiSigns.  
You just need to copy the YouTube Playlist Link and paste in the YouTube Playlist app in OptiSigns.

This article will guide you through how to create and use a YouTube Playlist App.

## **Let's jump in and get started:**

First, you will need to have your screens set up and paired. For more information on how to do that, click [here](https://www.optisigns.com/blog/how-to-set-up-digital-signs-with-optisigns-and-amazon-fire-tv).

Then log on to our portal: [https://app.optisigns.com/](http://app.optisigns.com/)

Go to **Files/Assets**, then click on **Apps:**

![OptiSigns Files/Assets page with the Apps button highlighted in the left sidebar.](https://support.optisigns.com/hc/article_attachments/55402483468563)

Click **YouTube Playlist** app:

![Add App dialog searched for Youtube Playlist, with the YouTube Playlist app tile highlighted.](https://support.optisigns.com/hc/article_attachments/55402502821395)

Enter your YouTube Playlist information:

![YouTube Playlist form: Name and URL fields, Caption and Shuffle toggles, Close and Save buttons.](https://support.optisigns.com/hc/article_attachments/55402502823443)

- Name: Give your YouTube Playlist a name. This is for displaying in your asset list only. The app will try to get the video's title and use as a name, but you can change it to something else.
- URL: Paste the link to your YouTube playlist here.
- Caption: Toggle Captions on or off. If the YouTube video has closed caption, the app will show it. Note: closed caption must be created by the YouTube video author. Auto-generated captions may not work.
- Shuffle: Toggle Shuffle on or off. This will randomize the videos within the Playlist.

# How to use YouTube Channel with OptiSigns

Article URL: https://support.optisigns.com/hc/en-us/articles/360060202914-How-to-use-YouTube-Channel-with-OptiSigns
Article ID: 360060202914
Source updated: 2026-09-10T09:44:55Z

Putting YouTube Channel on your digital signs screens is easy with OptiSigns.  
You just need to copy the YouTube Channel Link and paste in the YouTube Channel app in OptiSigns.

This article will guide you through how to create and use a YouTube Channel App.

## **Let's jump in and get started:**

First, you will need to have your screens set up and paired. For more information on how to do that, click [here](https://www.optisigns.com/blog/how-to-set-up-digital-signs-with-optisigns-and-amazon-fire-tv).

Then log on to our portal: <http://app.optisigns.com/>

Go to Files/Assets, Click on "App".

![mceclip0.png](https://support.optisigns.com/hc/article_attachments/360102767333)

Click YouTube Channel app:

![mceclip1.png](https://support.optisigns.com/hc/article_attachments/1500001754981)

Enter your YouTube Channel information:

![mceclip2.png](https://support.optisigns.com/hc/article_attachments/360102767413)

- Name: Give your YouTube Channel a name. This is for displaying in your asset list only. The app will try to get the video's title and use it as a name, but you can change it to something else.
- URL: Paste the link to your YouTube Channel here.
- Caption: If the YouTube video has a closed caption, the app will show it. Note: closed caption must be created by the YouTube video author, auto-generated caption may not work.

Click Save.

After Saving, you can Preview videos to verify.

**NOTE:** YouTube has made some changes to the way they format their channel URLs. There are a couple of extra steps we may need to follow to obtain the correct URL. OptiSigns YouTube applications will not work with the new URLs formatted with the channel name. (YouTube.com/channel/@[ChannelName]) We need the URL with the channel ID.

Here is how to obtain it.
